revision.comment: added 'Theology' to Christian theology and 'Governance' to Ecclesiastical polity
added a tax status field which is shown in the docs but missing from the template
adding another field shown in the docs but not present in the template
restrict parameter usage to 'off' to avoid unexpected result for parameter values other than 'on' or 'off'.
Remove background color and center text in name field, since it's outside the bordered part of the infobox
increasing the width and title text size slightly
changed "Official Website" to "Official website" to be consistent with other field titles
adding abbreviation for consistency with [[template:infobox organization]]
Geographical areas -> Region; removing unused parameters
/* top */ removed space in parameter label27
replace {{PAGENAME}} with {{PAGENAMEBASE}} to remove any disambiguation if article name is used as infobox title, using [[Project:AWB|AWB]]
Notifying of move discussion on [[Template talk:Infobox Christian branch#Requested move 9 January 2017 |Template talk:Infobox Christian branch]]

revision.comment: added 'Theology' to Christian theology and 'Governance' to Ecclesiastical polity
added a tax status field which is shown in the docs but missing from the template
adding another field shown in the docs but not present in the template
restrict parameter usage to 'off' to avoid unexpected result for parameter values other than 'on' or 'off'.
Remove background color and center text in name field, since it's outside the bordered part of the infobox
increasing the width and title text size slightly
changed "Official Website" to "Official website" to be consistent with other field titles
adding abbreviation for consistency with [[template:infobox organization]]
Geographical areas -> Region; removing unused parameters
/* top */ removed space in parameter label27
replace {{PAGENAME}} with {{PAGENAMEBASE}} to remove any disambiguation if article name is used as infobox title, using [[Project:AWB|AWB]]
Notifying of move discussion on [[Template talk:Infobox Christian branch#Requested move 9 January 2017 |Template talk:Infobox Christian branch]]

revision.comment: added 'Theology' to Christian theology and 'Governance' to Ecclesiastical polity
added a tax status field which is shown in the docs but missing from the template
adding another field shown in the docs but not present in the template
restrict parameter usage to 'off' to avoid unexpected result for parameter values other than 'on' or 'off'.
Remove background color and center text in name field, since it's outside the bordered part of the infobox
increasing the width and title text size slightly
changed "Official Website" to "Official website" to be consistent with other field titles
adding abbreviation for consistency with [[template:infobox organization]]
Geographical areas -> Region; removing unused parameters
/* top */ removed space in parameter label27
replace {{PAGENAME}} with {{PAGENAMEBASE}} to remove any disambiguation if article name is used as infobox title, using [[Project:AWB|AWB]]
Notifying of move discussion on [[Template talk:Infobox Christian branch#Requested move 9 January 2017 |Template talk:Infobox Christian branch]]
